patch_description: The best prior variant (bidirectional Kalman + SG window 2W+1) scored 0.63 with the lowest slope_changes (27.2) and false_reversals (23.8). The current program regressed on those reversal metrics by using 2W+3 and a softer stage-3.5 blend. This edit: (1) reverts the SG window to the proven crossover sizing 2W+1 (the extra group delay of 2W+3 is not fully recovered by the recency weighting, generating more lag-induced reversals), and (2) co-tunes the snap passes toward the proven "lower threshold, higher blend" pattern: stage 3.5 blend 0.5→0.6, stage 4 threshold 0.5→0.45 with blend 0.6→0.7, so sub-noise steps are removed more completely. Both changes stay inside the champion cascade — no new stages, no slope-domain or endpoint-regression tricks.
